report.caption: Caption
report.not_published: This report has not been published yet.

_tooltips.slug: The document's key in its address, unique within your organization. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only, e.g. getting-started.
_tooltips.title: The document's title as readers see it, e.g. Getting started.
_tooltips.subject: What the document is about, in one line.
_tooltips.description: A short summary of the document, e.g. for overviews and search results.
_tooltips.author: The byline shown with the document. Leave empty to use whoever created it.
_tooltips.sourceLocale: The language you write the document in; every other language version is a translation of it.
_tooltips.isPublic: Tick to let anyone read the published document without signing in; Reader roles are then ignored.
_tooltips.readerRoles: Roles allowed to read the document, one chip each, e.g. staff. Leave empty to let every signed-in member of the organization read it.
_tooltips.editorRoles: Roles allowed to change the document's content and properties, one chip each, e.g. editor.
_tooltips.publisherRoles: Roles allowed to publish the document, one chip each. Leave empty to let the editor roles publish too.
_tooltips.inputPorts: Values the page embedding the document hands in, e.g. the customer being viewed, so widgets in the document can use them.
_tooltips.outputPorts: Values the document hands back to the page embedding it, e.g. a record the reader selected.
_tooltips.kind: DOCUMENT is one fixed page; REPORT_TEMPLATE is a layout rendered once per object, e.g. one invoice per order, with its entity ports filled in each time.

_tooltips.name: Name the embedding page uses to pass or receive this value, unique among the document's ports, e.g. customer.
_tooltips.type: Kind of value: text, number, yes/no, date, object or list, or ENTITY_REF / ENTITY_COLLECTION for one or many records of an entity type.
_tooltips.required: Whether the embedding page must supply this value. If not ticked, the default value is used when nothing is supplied.
_tooltips.description: What the value means, for whoever embeds the document.
_tooltips.entityType: For ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION only: the entity type of the record(s), e.g. Order.
_tooltips.attributeVisibility: For ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION only: which attributes of the records are shown. mode is ALL, INCLUDE or EXCLUDE; attributes lists the attribute names it applies to.
_tooltips.defaultValue: Value used when the port is not required and the embedding page supplies nothing, e.g. 10.
_tooltips.defaultRsqlFilter: For ENTITY_COLLECTION only: which records to show when the page supplies no filter, as an RSQL query, e.g. status==OPEN.

_tooltips.description: What the value means, for whoever embeds the document.
